protocol.scope: Exploratory tracker transfer to two previously scored NBHL recordings, four 90-second clips. These labels are reused, not a fresh hidden test. All 120 originally fixed target frames are included.
protocol.seed_selection: Top YOLO score times appearance, minimum .01; development operating point already frozen. No target-frame predictions or reference coordinates seed SAM.
protocol.tracker: sam3 box10, GPU state, 512x384 native crop, +/-6 frames. No camera calibration available on these clips.

variants.sam_consensus: Both seed masks valid; both target masks visible/shape-valid/inside image/crop; target centers within12px. Return midpoint.
variants.sam_appearance: Among valid seed/target masks with target appearance>=.2 choose highest target appearance.
variants.hybrid_consensus: Use sam_consensus when available, otherwise retain frozen target-frame YOLO output.

protocol.unknown: Excluded from accuracy; output count reported separately.
